rationale: Start with a broad gradient to locate the elution window and critical pairs while minimizing the risk of missing strongly retained compounds. A moderate temperature leaves room to tune selectivity in either direction.

The shallower gradient improved the critical pair from R 0.46 to 1.20. Raise temperature by one step to test selectivity at that pair while bringing the last peak farther below 10 minutes.

The critical pair converged as temperature rose from 40 to 45 C; testing 55 C may separate it again after an elution-order reversal. Keep the gradient unchanged to isolate temperature selectivity while further shortening retention.

Shorten the gradient one step at the favorable temperature. Since the critical pair has reversed order, a steeper gradient may now increase its separation while reducing the last-peak time; the neighboring pair at R 2.18 provides some margin.

Injection 5 has reached the maximum CRF and remains the benchmark. Shorten the gradient one more step to test the fastest fully resolved method, watching especially the neighboring pair currently at R 1.59.

Restore injection 5’s successful gradient slope using a narrower organic window and a higher starting fraction. This should shorten retention while approximately preserving critical-pair selectivity; the first peak’s estimated elution fraction of 0.104 makes its retention worth monitoring.

Keep injection 5 as the maximum-score benchmark while testing a faster selectivity regime. Higher starting organic and temperature may carry the current limiting pair through an order reversal, but early-peak compression must be checked.

Lower the starting organic fraction to restore early-peak retention and test whether the compressed middle cluster opens up. Retain the short gradient and high temperature to explore faster separation, with injection 5 preserved as the maximum-score benchmark.

Test whether a substantially steeper gradient separates the middle pair further after its apparent order reversal at 60 C. This probes a faster separation regime while retaining low starting organic to protect the early peaks; injection 5 remains the maximum-score benchmark.
